channel.title: Circuit & Capital
channel.description: Sourced operator briefings on AI spend, agents, chips, cyber, and policy. Written by Emilio Santos.

item.title: Citrix NetScaler Is on the Exploited Catalog Again
item.description: CISA added CVE-2026-88779 on October 4. The catalog due date is October 7. The September NetScaler rows are a different pair of bugs.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Ask a Vendor for an SBOM
item.description: CISA’s 2026 minimum elements apply to SaaS and AI software. Ask for the fields, the format, and the date. A slide is not a bill of materials.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Extra Questions for an AI Bill of Materials
item.description: The May 12, 2026 G7 and CISA note is an add-on, not a replacement. A model name with no components is not an ingredients list.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Limit What an Agent Can Touch
item.description: In Gartner’s second-quarter survey of 297 security leaders, 54% have no defined limit on agent access, or they reuse a person’s access.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Stop Using a Voice as Approval
item.description: Gartner’s September 30 note: do not authorize a decision because someone recognized a face or a voice. Pair detection with another authenticator and a provenance check.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: What Article 50 Asks a Buyer
item.description: Transparency has applied since August 2, 2026. The December 2, 2026 date is a marking transition for systems already shipping, not a delay of the whole Act.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: The Cloud Shared-Responsibility Checklist
item.description: AWS’s model is security of the cloud versus security in the cloud. A managed database does not move your backup duty. An EC2 instance does not move the patch duty.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: What Belongs in a Processor Clause
item.description: The Commission adopted two different sets of standard clauses on June 4, 2021. One governs a processor inside the EEA. The other governs a transfer out. Do not sign the wrong PDF.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Before the Form 8-K Clock
item.description: The SEC’s clock is four business days from the materiality determination. Write down who can make that call, and what a private vendor must be able to say.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: A One-Page AI Use Rule
item.description: NIST’s AI RMF 1.0 is voluntary and organized as Govern, Map, Measure, and Manage. Use those four lines. Cite the version. A revision is in progress.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Questions Before a Post-Quantum Pilot
item.description: Gartner’s September 30 note: start a pilot, or expect at least double the migration cost after 2027. Fifty-one percent of surveyed CISOs had not started.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: The SEC Proposed a Path for Crypto Custody
item.description: On October 1 the Commission proposed custody rules for crypto assets held by advisers and regulated funds. The posts are the alert. Comments run from the Federal Register.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Astra Ultrafast Is a Speed Claim. The Bill Is Still Yours.
item.description: NVIDIA says GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast is up to 8x faster than Astra Standard on token generation. That number is theirs. The invoice is yours.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: NVIDIA Put the Fence Outside the Agent
item.description: On September 28 NVIDIA posted that OpenShell enforces what an agent may do, and that a BlueField chip can watch from outside the software the agent runs in.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: CISA Listed Three Bugs Attackers Are Already Using
item.description: WordPress on September 25, Apple on September 29, Cisco SD-WAN Manager on September 30. The posts are the alerts. The catalog holds the due dates.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Five Moves Gartner Wants from CISOs Before 2027
item.description: A September 30 note treats agents as insiders, a familiar voice as a weak approval, and post-quantum work as something that gets expensive if it waits.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: The EU AI Act Did Not Slip. The High-Risk Part Did.
item.description: Article 50 transparency has been in force since August 2. Stand-alone high-risk duties move to December 2, 2027. A US buyer still has to ask which date the vendor is selling.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: The Software Ingredients List Now Covers the Suite
item.description: CISA’s July 29 revision of the SBOM minimum elements applies to SaaS and AI software, not only to code you compile. The new fields are the ones to ask for.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: The SEC Clock Starts When You Decide It Matters
item.description: Public companies disclose a material cyber incident on Form 8-K within four business days of the materiality call. The annual report still has to describe who watches the risk.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Gartner Revised the AI Bill. Most of It Is Not Your Budget.
item.description: The September forecast is $2.7 trillion, up 49.5%. About 56% of the table is infrastructure. The check a company signs is the feature inside software it already owns.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Cyber Insurance Checklist for Mid-Market IT Budgets (2026)
item.description: MFA, EDR, immutable backups, IR retainer, and who owns broker versus IT while rates are still walking down.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: When Cloud Repatriation Is a Finance Decision, Not an Engineering Slogan
item.description: Cost drivers, FinOps questions, and stay-versus-leave — with a labeled list-price egress example, not a fake calculator.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: How to Tell AI Spend from AI Return
item.description: Seat cost versus token cost, pilot versus production, and questions a board can ask. No guaranteed-return claims.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Software Buying as an Operating Skill
item.description: RFP basics, seat waste, who signs, and the three SaaS-management jobs. The stack is the company.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: How to Read a SaaS Renewal
item.description: A 90-day pass: seats, overlap, price, and the exit before you answer the increase.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: What a Cyber Insurer Will Still Ask
item.description: MFA, EDR, backups, privilege, retainer — even when rates are falling.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Put an AI Cost on One Workflow
item.description: Tokens, review time, and rework on a single process with a definition of done.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: AI Spend Is Not the Same as AI Return
item.description: Gartner sees $2.59 trillion in AI spending this year. McKinsey still finds only a minority of firms attributing EBIT to it.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Chip Licenses Keep Moving. The Mid-Tier Still Waits.
item.description: BIS opened a case-by-case window for H200-class chips. Korea tightened AI-chip exports on Sept. 1.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Cyber Insurance Got Cheaper. The Questionnaire Did Not.
item.description: Swiss Re puts 2026 global cyber premium at $16.4 billion with rates still down. The application still wants MFA.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Software Buying Is an Operating Skill
item.description: The stack is no longer an IT catalog. It is how the company actually runs — and most firms still buy it like office supplies.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: When Compliance Is the Product
item.description: Data residency, audit trails, and model clauses are no longer legal footnotes. They are packaging.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: The AI Productivity Paradox at Mid-Market Companies
item.description: Tools landed in every department. Output did not. The bottleneck is workflow, not the model.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Private Credit Is Quietly Funding the Software Roll-Up
item.description: When public markets froze on multiples, direct lenders stepped in — and started acting like operators.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Chip Export Controls and the Suppliers Caught in Between
item.description: Policy is written in Washington. The P&L lands on toolmakers, packagers, and the mid-tier vendors nobody briefed.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Cyber Insurance Is Rewriting the IT Budget
item.description: Underwriters now ask better questions than some boards. The answers are showing up as line items.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: The New Unit Economics of AI-Native Startups
item.description: Gross margin is no longer a software story. Token costs, evals, and human review decide who scales.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Cloud Repatriation: When the Bill Becomes the Strategy
item.description: Finance is pulling workloads home. Engineering is discovering that “home” is a product decision, not a protest.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Six Questions Every Board Should Ask About Generative AI
item.description: Most decks still sell possibility. Directors need a control framework that survives the next vendor cycle.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)

item.title: Retail Media Networks Are Eating the Digital Ad Market
item.description: Closed-loop purchase data beat the open web. The next fight is over who owns the aisle.
item.author: circuit50capital@circuits.fit (Emilio Santos)
